description: The block structure that attempts code, handles a matching exception and always runs cleanup code at the end.
A try form that declares an AutoCloseable resource and closes it automatically, even when an exception is thrown.
An Exception that is not a RuntimeException; the compiler requires it to be caught or declared with throws.
A RuntimeException subclass, such as IllegalArgumentException, that the compiler does not force you to handle.
The statement that raises an exception object and starts unwinding the call stack.
A small piece of code that calls your code and uses assert to fail when the result is not the expected one.
A Java statement that throws AssertionError when its condition is false, evaluated only when the program runs with -ea.
